Mara Voss.bio: Surveyed washed-out roads for caravan crews. Marks every passable bridge on a map folded into his boot.

Tessa Ward.bio: Kept a farm pump running on parts from a broken jukebox. Carries spare fuses in a tobacco tin.

Rhea Cole.bio: Ran night deliveries between settlements until the trail went quiet. Still travels with his boots wrapped in cloth.

Nadia Quinn.bio: Learned to track leaks by sound while repairing a settlement cistern. Followed the pipes to your vault.

Owen Hale.bio: Organized meals at a crowded caravan stop. Can talk a roomful of strangers into sharing their last tin of beans.

Silas Knox.bio: Salvaged and reinforced shelters along an old rail line. Checks every beam before calling a room safe.

Theo Mercer.bio: Cooked for road crews through two winters with one stove. Brought a patched apron and a list of supplies your diner can stretch.
